recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a comparable rendering issue exists in the current QI-Core IG, address it in the FHIR-us-qicore source or current publishing toolchain as a separate issue rather than changing current HL7/fhir core source for this retired bundled profile.
issue_request: FHIR-8705 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request about the old QI-Core AdverseEvent rendering at build.fhir.org/qicore/qicore-adverseevent.html. It asked that qicore-adverseevent-cause render item and certainty extension repetitions correctly, avoid extra extension/certainty repetitions, and avoid showing value[x] for a complex extension.
initial_application: Jira's application comment names SVN revision 7169, which maps to git commit 52fb8e4178eced3cf2da788c126ae1cdd4a3ce20, '#8705 - fix Adverse Event rendering'. That commit changed the old ProfileUtilities/ProfileGenerator renderer code to locate extension fragments and render complex extensions and cardinalities correctly.
additional_context: The affected artifact was a DSTU-era QI-Core profile bundled with core. Current core source has the qicore IG entry commented out in source/igs.xml, no active QI-Core profile entry in source/fhir.ini, no qicore source files in the core or Extension Pack checkouts, and no current ProfileUtilities.java/ProfileGenerator.java paths. Related current QI-Core AdverseEvent work appears under FHIR-us-qicore rather than this HL7/fhir core checkout.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The correct reconciliation is an empty external-repo audit because there is no in-build QI-Core AdverseEvent profile source to edit in HL7/fhir and the historical fix was already applied to tooling that is no longer present in the current checkout.
